sql: WITH b0 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) < 100 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) END AS fy, CAST(funds_center_number AS VARCHAR) AS center, CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) AS account_number, dept_name, account, amount FROM "analysis_regional_data_6248b76b917ad88fb00a1800" WHERE CAST(fund_number AS VARCHAR) = '100000' AND CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%' AND lower(trim(budget_cycle)) = 'adopted'), a0 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) < 100 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) END AS fy, CAST(funds_center_number AS VARCHAR) AS center, CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) AS account_number, dept_name, account, amount FROM "analysis_regional_data_7ee003c264e5cfe2fe14254e" WHERE CAST(fund_number AS VARCHAR) = '100000' AND CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%' ), period AS (SELECT MAX(b0.fy) AS fy FROM (SELECT DISTINCT fy FROM b0) b0 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fy FROM a0) a0 ON b0.fy=a0.fy WHERE b0.fy <= 2026), b AS (SELECT fy, center, account_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT dept_name, ' | ' ORDER BY dept_name) AS departments, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT account, ' | ' ORDER BY account) AS account_labels, SUM(amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT(amount) AS missing_amounts FROM b0 WHERE fy = (SELECT fy FROM period) GROUP BY 1,2,3), a AS (SELECT fy, center, account_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT dept_name, ' | ' ORDER BY dept_name) AS departments, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT account, ' | ' ORDER BY account) AS account_labels, SUM(amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT(amount) AS missing_amounts FROM a0 WHERE fy = (SELECT fy FROM period) GROUP BY 1,2,3) SELECT COALESCE(b.fy,a.fy) AS fiscal_year, COALESCE(b.center,a.center) AS funds_center_number, COALESCE(b.account_number,a.account_number) AS account_number, b.departments AS budget_departments, a.departments AS actual_departments, COALESCE(a.account_labels,b.account_labels) AS account, b.amount AS adopted_budget, a.amount AS actual_spending, b.source_rows AS budget_rows, a.source_rows AS actual_rows, b.missing_amounts AS budget_nulls, a.missing_amounts AS actual_nulls, CASE WHEN b.source_rows IS NULL THEN 'Missing budget baseline' WHEN a.source_rows IS NULL THEN 'Missing actuals' WHEN b.missing_amounts > 0 OR a.missing_amounts > 0 THEN 'Incomplete amounts' ELSE 'Matched' END AS comparison_status, CASE WHEN b.missing_amounts=0 AND a.missing_amounts=0 THEN a.amount-b.amount END AS actual_minus_adopted FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN a ON b.fy=a.fy AND b.center=a.center AND b.account_number=a.account_number WHERE (contains(lower(COALESCE(a.departments,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(b.departments,'')), 'police') OR contains(lower(COALESCE(a.departments,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(b.departments,'')), 'homeless') OR contains(lower(COALESCE(a.departments,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(b.departments,'')), 'park') OR contains(lower(COALESCE(a.departments,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(b.departments,'')), 'librar')) ORDER BY ABS(CASE WHEN b.source_rows IS NULL THEN a.amount WHEN a.source_rows IS NULL THEN b.amount ELSE a.amount-b.amount END) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 24

label: Latest explicitly adopted General Fund allocation changes and service tradeoffs
sql: WITH b0 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) < 100 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) END AS fy, CAST(funds_center_number AS VARCHAR) AS center, CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) AS account_number, dept_name, account, amount FROM "analysis_regional_data_6248b76b917ad88fb00a1800" WHERE CAST(fund_number AS VARCHAR) = '100000' AND CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%' AND lower(trim(budget_cycle)) = 'adopted'), period AS (SELECT MAX(fy) AS fy FROM b0 WHERE fy <= 2027), totals AS (SELECT fy,dept_name,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=COUNT(amount) THEN SUM(amount) END AS adopted FROM b0 WHERE (contains(lower(dept_name), 'police') OR contains(lower(dept_name), 'homeless') OR contains(lower(dept_name), 'park') OR contains(lower(dept_name), 'librar')) GROUP BY 1,2), current_year AS (SELECT * FROM totals WHERE fy=(SELECT fy FROM period)), prior_year AS (SELECT * FROM totals WHERE fy=(SELECT fy-1 FROM period)) SELECT (SELECT fy FROM period) AS fiscal_year,COALESCE(c.dept_name,p.dept_name) AS department,p.adopted AS prior_adopted,c.adopted AS current_adopted,c.adopted-p.adopted AS allocation_change FROM current_year c FULL OUTER JOIN prior_year p ON c.dept_name=p.dept_name ORDER BY ABS(allocation_change) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 24

label: Police overtime: adopted allocation versus actual spending in ended fiscal years
sql: WITH b0 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) < 100 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) END AS fy, CAST(funds_center_number AS VARCHAR) AS center, CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) AS account_number, dept_name, account, amount FROM "analysis_regional_data_6248b76b917ad88fb00a1800" WHERE CAST(fund_number AS VARCHAR) = '100000' AND CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%' AND lower(trim(budget_cycle)) = 'adopted'), a0 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) < 100 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) END AS fy, CAST(funds_center_number AS VARCHAR) AS center, CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) AS account_number, dept_name, account, amount FROM "analysis_regional_data_7ee003c264e5cfe2fe14254e" WHERE CAST(fund_number AS VARCHAR) = '100000' AND CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%' ), period AS (SELECT MAX(b0.fy) AS fy FROM (SELECT DISTINCT fy FROM b0) b0 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fy FROM a0) a0 ON b0.fy=a0.fy WHERE b0.fy <= 2026), b AS (SELECT fy,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=COUNT(amount) THEN SUM(amount) END AS adopted FROM b0 WHERE lower(trim(dept_name))='police' AND contains(lower(account),'overtime') GROUP BY fy), a AS (SELECT fy,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=COUNT(amount) THEN SUM(amount) END AS actual FROM a0 WHERE lower(trim(dept_name))='police' AND contains(lower(account),'overtime') GROUP BY fy) SELECT COALESCE(b.fy,a.fy) AS fiscal_year,b.adopted AS adopted_overtime,a.actual AS actual_overtime,a.actual-b.adopted AS overtime_variance FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN a ON a.fy=b.fy WHERE COALESCE(b.fy,a.fy) BETWEEN (SELECT fy-2 FROM period) AND (SELECT fy FROM period) ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
